configure.title: Nīnau
configure.description: Nīnau e pane ai nā mea hoʻohana.

configure.title: Kaulele
configure.description: E hoʻonohonoho kaulele i nā pane.

configure.title: Pane hoʻokahi
configure.description: E ʻae i hoʻokahi pane wale nō.

advanced.title: Hiki ke hōʻuku
advanced.description: E hōʻike i kēia nīnau ma ke ʻano lālani e wehe ʻia a pani ʻia. ʻO ka wehe ʻana i kekahi, pani ia i nā nīnau hōʻuku ʻē aʻe ma ka ʻaoʻao.

advanced.title: E hoʻomaka me ka hōʻuku ʻia
advanced.description: I ka wā hiki ke hōʻuku, hoʻomaka ma ke ʻano lālani pani ʻia e hōʻike ana i ka nīnau a me kona kūlana wale nō.

advanced.title: ʻAno helu kaha
advanced.description: OER Schema: ke ʻano helu kaha no kēia loiloi (e laʻa me nā kiko, ka hua, ka pākēneka, ka hoʻopau).

advanced.title: Pahuhopu aʻo
advanced.description: OER Schema: ka pahuhopu aʻo e pili ana i kēia loiloi.

developer.title: Inoa o ka hōʻike
developer.description: Inoa hōʻike i hoʻohana ʻia no ka ʻike xAPI ma nā ʻōnaehana kālailai.

developer.title: Papa
developer.description: OER Schema: ka papa i manaʻo ʻia ai kēia loiloi.
